nodes.label:
Create New
Calendar
nodes.title: Create New Calendar
nodes.info: A calendar distinct from any mentor's personal calendar. Putting club sessions on a personal calendar means they leave with that mentor.

nodes.label: Name It Clearly
nodes.title: Name It Clearly
nodes.info: For example, 'Tuesday Coding Club 2026', not the default 'Calendar 3'. The name is what a parent sees when they subscribe.

nodes.label:
Set Default
Visibility
nodes.title: Set Default Visibility
nodes.info: Typically view-only for anyone with the link, reserving edit access for the lead mentor. Setting this before sharing avoids retrofitting permissions later.

nodes.label:
Add Recurring
Sessions
nodes.title: Add Recurring Sessions
nodes.info: Every session date for the semester added as one recurring weekly event, not one at a time. A single recurrence rule is also a single place to edit when a date moves.

nodes.label: Share the Link
nodes.title: Share the Link
nodes.info: The link goes out to families and mentors, and shared calendar access rules take over from here.
